q: 你参加一个拍卖会，规则是出价最高者赢得拍品，但出价第二高者也需要支付自己的出价且一无所获。你发现只剩你和另一个竞拍者，目前你的出价是第二高。你会：
b: 继续加价，避免成为输家

q: 你和对手各自在纸上写一个1-100之间的整数，谁写的数字最接近对方数字的2/3，谁获胜。你认为对手会随机选择，你会写：
a: 33（基于对手随机选择的平均期望）
b: 22（预判对手会写33而进行反制）

q: 团队合作项目中，你的贡献将决定整体奖金，但奖金会平均分配。你知道有成员可能摸鱼。此时你会：
a: 依然全力贡献，相信团队精神
b: 降低个人投入，避免被搭便车

q: 谈判陷入僵局，对方突然提出一个明显不利于自己的方案，但要求你立即接受。你会：
b: 拒绝，怀疑对方有隐藏意图

q: 你有一笔投资，已亏损40%。现在有一个机会：高风险高回报，可能回本也可能全损。你会：
b: 冒险一搏，试图翻盘

q: 多人投票决定是否通过一个对集体有利但损害少数人利益的方案。你是少数方，但有机会在投票前贿赂一名关键投票者。你会：
a: 尝试贿赂，保护自身利益
b: 拒绝贿赂，遵守规则

q: 猜拳比赛中，对手连续三次出“石头”。下一局你会出：
a: 剪刀（相信对方会改变模式）
b: 布（预判对方会延续惯性）

q: 你和陌生人同时决定合作或背叛。合作则双方各得3分，背叛则各得1分；若一人合作一人背叛，合作者得0分，背叛者得5分。仅进行一轮时，你会：
a: 选择合作，寻求共赢可能
b: 选择背叛，确保自身安全

q: 市场上有两个相似产品，A价格高质量稳，B价格低质量未知。作为消费者你会选：
b: B，尝试性价比可能

q: 你需要分配100元给自己和匿名对手，若对方拒绝你的方案，双方都得0元。你会分给对方：
b: 50元（确保对方接受）

q: 在公共物品博弈中，你发现多数参与者选择搭便车。此时你会：
a: 坚持合作，希望带动他人
b: 转为搭便车，避免被剥削

q: 拍卖会上，你与唯一对手竞拍一件你们估值相近的物品。你会选择：
a: 激进出价，试图吓退对手
b: 温和出价，避免赢家的诅咒

q: 重复囚徒困境中，对手上一轮背叛了你。这一轮你会：
a: 选择合作，给予一次原谅机会
b: 选择背叛，实施以牙还牙策略

q: 作为谈判新手，面对经验丰富的对手。你会优先：
b: 隐藏信息，保持灵活性

q: 在信任博弈中，你是接收方，获得了对方大部分资金。你会：
a: 返还可观金额以建立长期信任
b: 保留大部分，因为这是单次博弈

q: 市场进入博弈中，作为潜在新进入者，你发现现有企业威胁说会降价反击。你会：
b: 进入市场，认为威胁不可信

q: 团队任务中，你的贡献难以被单独衡量。此时你会：
a: 全力以赴，相信同伴也会如此
b: 适当摸鱼，避免成为唯一努力者

q: 最后通牒博弈中，你是提议者，要给对方分配一笔钱。你会：
a: 提出接近均分的公平方案
b: 提出极度不均但对方可能接受的最低方案

q: 猜硬币游戏中，你需要预测对手的选择。连续三次都是正面后，第四次你认为：
a: 该出反面了，遵循概率平衡
b: 继续选正面，认为对手有模式

q: 作为后来者，你要在一个已有稳定格局的市场推出新产品。你会：
b: 寻找利基市场，避免正面冲突

q: 在一个拍卖会上，你和一个对手竞拍一件价值100元的物品。规则是：出价最高者获胜，但前两名出价者都需要支付自己的出价。你会选择：
a: 出价略高于50元，争取以合理价格获胜。
b: 出价远低于50元，避免陷入“赢家的诅咒”。

q: 你和对手分10枚金币。对方先提出分配方案，如果你接受则按方案分配，如果拒绝则两人都得不到金币。你会：
a: 只要对方分给自己不少于3枚就接受，避免一无所获。
b: 除非对方分给自己不少于5枚，否则拒绝以示公平。

q: 作为餐厅常客，你发现服务员多找了零钱。你们未来很可能再次见面。你会：
a: 立即归还多找的钱，建立诚信声誉。
b: 默默收下，视为偶然收益。

q: 团队项目中，你的贡献对成果影响很大，但努力成本很高。你会：
a: 全力投入，相信他人也会同样努力。
b: 适度摸鱼，避免成为“冤大头”。

q: 你要向陌生人传递一个重要信息，但无法确认对方是否可信。你会：
a: 先透露部分信息，观察对方反应再决定是否全盘托出。
b: 直接提供完整信息，以诚意换取信任。

q: 市场上有两家竞争店铺，节日促销在即。你会选择：
a: 率先公布折扣方案，抢占先机。
b: 等待对手先出牌，再针对性调整策略。

q: 你在一个陌生城市迷路，手机没电。面前有两条路，你会询问：
a: 那个看起来匆忙但衣着得体的人。
b: 那个悠闲坐着但衣着随意的人。

q: 多人投票决定团体去向，你的真实偏好是选项X，但发现选项Y明显更受欢迎。你会：
a: 坚持投票给X，表达真实意愿。
b: 改投Y，避免成为少数派而影响社交关系。

q: 谈判陷入僵局时，对方突然大幅让步。你会认为：
a: 这是达成合作的真诚信号，应积极回应。
b: 对方可能隐藏了不利信息，需更加警惕。

q: 投资中，你持有的股票已亏损20%，但行业前景不明。你会：
a: 立即止损卖出，避免更大损失。
b: 继续持有等待反弹，不愿承认决策失误。

q: 你参加一个拍卖会，规则是出价最高者获胜，但前两名都需要支付自己的出价。你已出价100元，现在有人出价110元。你会：
b: 放弃竞价，避免更大损失

q: 你和对手各有一个按钮，如果只有一人按下按钮，按下者得100元，对方得0；如果两人都按，各得10元；都不按，各得50元。你会：
b: 不按按钮

q: 你和陌生人分100元，对方提出方案（如自己拿70元，给你30元），你只能接受或拒绝。若拒绝，双方都得0。对方提出他拿70元，你拿30元。你会：
b: 拒绝

q: 你和对手轮流从100元中取钱，每次可取1-10元，取完最后一次的人额外获得20元奖金。你先手。你会：
b: 第一次取1元

q: 你和对手独立选择“合作”或“背叛”。若都合作，各得3分；都背叛，各得1分；一方合作一方背叛，背叛者得5分，合作者得0分。你会：
b: 背叛

q: 你面前有两个信封，一个金额是另一个的两倍。你随机选了一个，打开是100元。主持人问是否换另一个信封。你会：
b: 不换

q: 你和对手各写一个1-100的整数，最接近平均数的2/3者获胜。你会写：
b: 一个极小的数（如1）

q: 你投资100元，有50%概率翻倍，50%概率亏光。你可以选择：
b: 不投资

q: 你和对手各有一份资源，可以投入公共项目（收益平分）或留给自己。每投入1元，公共项目产生1.5元总收益。你会：
b: 全部留给自己

q: 你参加一场比赛，奖金按排名递减。你可以选择努力（成本高但可能前列）或摸鱼（成本低但可能垫底）。你会：
b: 摸鱼

q: 你与对手竞拍一件价值100元的物品，双方同时出价，出价高者获胜但需支付自己的出价。若平局则随机分配。你会选择：
b: 出价1元

q: 在信任游戏中，你作为投资人拥有100元本金。你可以将任意金额交给对方，对方收到的金额会翻3倍后再决定返还多少给你。你会：
b: 投资0元

q: 两人分100元，由你提议分配比例，对方决定接受或拒绝。若拒绝则双方都得0元。你会提议：
b: 自己50元，对方50元

q: 你和对手各自选择“合作”或“背叛”。若双方合作各得3分；双方背叛各得1分；一方合作一方背叛，背叛者得5分，合作者得0分。你会：
b: 选择背叛

q: 三人投票决定如何分配200元。方案需超过半数同意才能通过。你作为提案者，会提议：
b: 自己120元，一人80元，另一人0元

q: 你与对手轮流从20枚硬币中取1-3枚，取走最后一枚者输。你先手，开局会取：
b: 3枚

q: 市场上有两家公司定价竞争。若都定高价各赚100万；都定低价各赚60万；一方高价一方低价，低价方赚150万，高价方赚30万。你会：
b: 定低价

q: 你参加一场笔试，成绩超过90%的考生即可获奖。考试难度由全体考生投票决定“难”或“易”。你会投票：
b: 难度低

q: 你发现同事的工作失误。举报可使你获得奖励但会损害对方利益；不举报则团队整体效率更高。你会：
b: 不举报

q: 你和对手各自在0-100间选一个数，最接近平均数的2/3者获胜。你会选择：

q_zh: 你与对手各持一枚硬币，同时选择正面或反面。若两枚硬币相同，你得3分；若不同，对手得2分。你会选择：
q_en: You and your opponent each hold a coin, choosing heads or tails simultaneously. If both coins match, you get 3 points; if they differ, your opponent gets 2 points. You choose:

q_zh: 在一个拍卖中，你和对手竞拍100元现金，出价高者获胜，但双方都需支付自己的出价。你会出价：
q_en: In an auction for $100 cash, the highest bidder wins, but both pay their bid. You bid:

q_zh: 你和对手需各自选择“合作”或“背叛”。若都合作，各得2分；都背叛，各得1分；若一方合作一方背叛，背叛者得3分，合作者得0分。你会：
q_en: You and your opponent choose 'Cooperate' or 'Defect'. If both cooperate, each gets 2 points; both defect, each gets 1; if one defects and one cooperates, the defector gets 3, the cooperator 0. You choose:

q_zh: 你与对手分10枚金币。你先提出分配方案（如“我7你3”），对手接受则按方案分配，拒绝则双方都得0。你会提议：
q_en: You and your opponent split 10 gold coins. You propose a split (e.g., 'I take 7, you take 3'). If accepted, it's implemented; if rejected, both get 0. You propose:

q_zh: 你与对手轮流从20枚金币中取走1-3枚，取走最后一枚者输。你先手，第一次会取几枚？
q_en: You and your opponent take turns taking 1-3 gold coins from a pile of 20. The player who takes the last coin loses. You go first. How many do you take?

q_zh: 你面前有两个按钮：A按钮确保你得100元，B按钮有50%概率你得250元，50%概率你得0元。你会按：
q_en: You face two buttons: Button A guarantees you $100; Button B gives a 50% chance of $250 and 50% chance of $0. You press:

q_zh: 你和对手同时写下1-100间的一个整数。谁写的数更接近对方所写数的2/3，谁获胜。你会写：
q_en: You and your opponent simultaneously write an integer between 1 and 100. Whoever's number is closest to 2/3 of the other's number wins. You write:

q_zh: 你与对手进行多轮囚徒困境。已知对手上一轮选择“合作”，你本轮会：
q_en: You and your opponent play multiple rounds of Prisoner's Dilemma. Knowing your opponent cooperated last round, you now:

q_zh: 你有一个秘密，告诉对手“真话”或“假话”。对手猜“真”或“假”。若猜对，对手得2分；若猜错，你得1分。你会说：
q_en: You have a secret and tell the opponent either 'Truth' or 'Lie'. They guess 'True' or 'False'. If correct, they get 2 points; if wrong, you get 1 point. You say:

q_zh: 你和对手各有一个数字（1-10），同时出示。若你的数字大于对手，你得数字对应的分数；若小于或等于，得0分。你会出示：
q_en: You and your opponent each have a number (1-10) and reveal simultaneously. If your number is higher, you get points equal to your number; if lower or equal, you get 0. You reveal:

q_zh: 你与对手各自秘密写下1-10中的一个数字。若数字相同，各得10分；若不同，数字较大者得5分，较小者得0分。你会写哪个数字？
q_en: You and your opponent secretly choose a number from 1 to 10. If you choose the same number, both get 10 points. If different, the one with the larger number gets 5 points, the smaller gets 0. What number do you choose?

q_zh: 在一个公共物品捐赠游戏中，你知道如果超过一半的人捐款，所有人都会受益，但你不知道其他人的选择。你会捐款吗？
q_en: In a public goods game, everyone benefits if more than half donate, but you don't know others' choices. Do you donate?

q_zh: 你和对手轮流提分蛋糕方案。你先提，若对方拒绝，蛋糕会缩小。你会提议自己分得多少比例？
q_en: You and an opponent take turns proposing how to split a cake. You propose first. If rejected, the cake shrinks. What share do you propose for yourself?

q_zh: 拍卖一件价值100元的物品，出价最高者获胜但需支付自己的出价，第二名无需支付。你会出价多少？
q_en: Auction an item worth 100. The highest bidder wins and pays their bid, the second pays nothing. How much do you bid?

q_zh: 作为公司经理，你怀疑员工会偷懒。你会选择严格监控，还是给予信任并设置激励？
q_en: As a manager, you suspect employees might shirk. Do you choose strict monitoring, or trust with incentives?

q_zh: 你要向陌生人发送一条消息，对方可能友好也可能敌对。你的第一条消息会是合作信号还是试探性威胁？
q_en: You send a message to a stranger who might be friendly or hostile. Is your first message a cooperative signal or a tentative threat?

q_zh: 在重复囚徒困境中，对方上一轮背叛了你。这一轮你会选择合作还是背叛？
q_en: In a repeated prisoner's dilemma, your opponent betrayed you last round. Do you cooperate or defect this round?

q_zh: 你需要分配100元给自己和一个陌生人。对方可以接受或拒绝，拒绝则双方都得0。你分给对方多少？
q_en: You divide 100 between yourself and a stranger. They can accept or reject; rejection gives both 0. How much do you give them?

q_zh: 市场上有两家竞争公司。你会选择与对手保持价格战，还是尝试达成隐性价格同盟？
q_en: Two competing firms in a market. Do you maintain a price war, or attempt a tacit price-fixing alliance?

q_zh: 你知道某个谣言是假的，但传播它可能让你获利。你会传播还是澄清？
q_en: You know a rumor is false, but spreading it might benefit you. Do you spread it or clarify the truth?

q_zh: 你与对手各自秘密写下1-10中的一个数字。若数字相同，各得10分；若数字不同，数字较小者得5分，较大者得0分。你会写哪个数字？
q_en: You and your opponent secretly choose a number from 1 to 10. If the numbers match, both get 10 points. If they differ, the smaller number gets 5 points, the larger gets 0. What number do you choose?

q_zh: 你与对手轮流从100枚金币中拿取1-10枚，拿完最后一枚者获胜。你先手，第一次会拿几枚？
q_en: You and your opponent take turns taking 1-10 gold coins from a pile of 100. Whoever takes the last coin wins. You go first. How many do you take initially?
b_zh: 拿特定数量（如4枚），试图控制序列
b_en: Take a specific number (e.g., 4) to try to control the sequence

q_zh: 拍卖一张100元纸币，出价最高者赢得纸币，但出价前两名都需支付自己的出价。你会出价多少？
q_en: Auction for a $100 bill. The highest bidder wins it, but the top two bidders both pay their bids. How much do you bid?

q_zh: 两人分10万元，由你提出分配方案（如“我7你3”）。若对方接受，按方案分；若拒绝，两人都得0。你会怎么提？
q_en: Split $100,000. You propose a division (e.g., 'I get 70%, you get 30%'). If accepted, it happens; if rejected, both get nothing. What do you propose?

q_zh: 猜拳游戏（石头剪刀布）连续10局。第一局你会出什么？
q_en: 10 consecutive rounds of Rock-Paper-Scissors. What do you play in the first round?

q_zh: 你与对手各有两个选择：合作（C）或背叛（D）。收益矩阵为：双方选C各得3；双方选D各得1；若一方选C一方选D，则选C者得0，选D者得5。这是一次性博弈，你会选？
q_en: You and your opponent choose Cooperate (C) or Defect (D). Payoffs: both C → 3 each; both D → 1 each; if one C one D, C gets 0, D gets 5. This is a one-shot game. You choose?

q_zh: 你面前有两个按钮：A按钮确保你获得500元；B按钮有50%概率获得1100元，50%概率得0。你会按哪个？
q_en: Two buttons: Button A guarantees $500. Button B gives a 50% chance of $1100, 50% chance of $0. Which do you press?

q_zh: 你与对手同时决定是否信任对方。若互信，各得4；互不信任，各得2；若一方信任而另一方不信任，信任者得1，不信任者得3。你会选择信任吗？
q_en: You and your opponent simultaneously decide whether to trust each other. Both trust → 4 each; both distrust → 2 each; if one trusts and the other distrusts, truster gets 1, distruster gets 3. Do you choose to trust?

q_zh: 你参加一个游戏：主持人给你看三个盒子，其中一个有奖。你选了一个后，主持人（知道奖品位置）打开另一个空盒子，然后问你是否换到剩下的那个盒子。你会换吗？
q_en: A game show: three boxes, one contains a prize. You pick one. The host (who knows where the prize is) opens an empty box from the remaining two, then asks if you want to switch to the other unopened box. Do you switch?

q_zh: 你与对手各有一个“核按钮”。若都不按，和平继续，各得10。若一人按，按者得15，不按者得0。若都按，核战爆发，各得-100。这是一次性同时决策，你会按吗？
q_en: You and your opponent each have a 'nuclear button'. If neither presses, peace continues (10 each). If one presses, presser gets 15, non-presser gets 0. If both press, nuclear war (-100 each). One-shot simultaneous decision. Do you press?

q_zh: 你与对手各自选择“合作”或“背叛”。若双方都合作，各得3分；都背叛，各得1分；一方合作一方背叛，背叛者得5分，合作者得0分。你会选择？
q_en: You and your opponent each choose 'Cooperate' or 'Betray'. If both cooperate, each gets 3 points; both betray, each gets 1 point; if one cooperates and the other betrays, the betrayer gets 5 points, the cooperator gets 0. What do you choose?

q_zh: 你和对手竞拍100元。出价最高者获胜并支付所出金额，但第二名也需支付自己的出价且一无所获。你会出价多少？
q_en: You and your opponent bid for $100. The highest bidder wins and pays their bid, but the second-highest also pays their bid and gets nothing. How much do you bid?

q_zh: 你和对手轮流从100元中取钱，每次可取1-10元，取完最后一次的人额外获得20元奖金。你先手，第一次会取多少？
q_en: You and your opponent take turns taking $1-10 from $100. The player who takes the last amount gets an extra $20 bonus. You go first. How much do you take initially?

q_zh: 你和对手同时决定是否“进攻”对方。若都不进攻，各得2分；都进攻，各失1分；一方进攻一方不进攻，进攻者得3分，不进攻者失2分。你会？
q_en: You and your opponent simultaneously decide whether to 'Attack' the other. If neither attacks, each gets 2 points; both attack, each loses 1 point; if one attacks and the other doesn't, the attacker gets 3 points, the non-attacker loses 2. What do you do?

q_zh: 你有一个信息，可以真实分享或虚假分享给对手。对手收到信息后会做一个对你有利或不利的决策。你会？
q_en: You have information that you can share truthfully or falsely with your opponent. After receiving it, they will make a decision that can benefit or harm you. What do you do?

q_zh: 你和对手各有一个数字（1-10），同时出示。若两数之和为奇数，你获胜；若为偶数，对手获胜。你会出几？
q_en: You and your opponent each choose a number (1-10) and reveal simultaneously. If the sum is odd, you win; if even, they win. What number do you choose?

q_zh: 你和对手需共同完成一个项目。若都努力，项目成功，各得4分；一人努力一人偷懒，项目勉强完成，努力者得2分，偷懒者得3分；都偷懒，项目失败，各得0分。你会？
q_en: You and your opponent must collaborate on a project. If both work hard, it succeeds and each gets 4 points; if one works hard and the other slacks, it barely finishes—hard worker gets 2, slacker gets 3; if both slack, it fails and each gets 0. What do you do?

q_zh: 你和对手分10枚金币。你提出分配方案（如“我得7枚，你得3枚”），对手接受则按方案分，拒绝则双方都得不到金币。你会提议如何分配？
q_en: You and your opponent split 10 gold coins. You propose a split (e.g., 'I take 7, you take 3'). If they accept, the split happens; if they reject, both get nothing. What do you propose?

q_zh: 你和对手玩三局“石头剪刀布”。每局胜者得1分，平局各得0.5分。已知对手上一局出了“石头”，你下一局会出什么？
q_en: You and your opponent play three rounds of Rock-Paper-Scissors. Each win gives 1 point, a draw gives 0.5 each. Knowing your opponent played 'Rock' last round, what do you play next?

q_zh: 你和对手各有一个秘密数字（1-100），同时公开。更接近对方数字两倍的人获胜。你会选哪个数字？
q_en: You and your opponent each secretly choose a number (1-100) and reveal simultaneously. Whoever is closer to twice the opponent's number wins. What number do you choose?

q_zh: 你与对手各自拥有100元。你们需要同时决定是否向公共池捐款。如果双方都捐款，每人获得150元回报；如果只有一方捐款，捐款者损失100元，未捐者获得50元；如果都不捐，保持原状。你会选择：
q_en: You and your opponent each have $100. You must simultaneously decide whether to donate to a public pool. If both donate, each gets $150. If only one donates, the donor loses $100 and the non-donor gets $50. If neither donates, both keep their $100. You choose:

q_zh: 你与对手轮流提出分100元的方案。你先提议，若对方拒绝，总金额减至80元并由对方提议。若再拒绝，双方得0元。你的第一次提议是：
q_en: You and your opponent take turns proposing how to split $100. You propose first. If rejected, the total drops to $80 and the opponent proposes. If rejected again, both get $0. Your first proposal is:

q_zh: 你与对手各有一张红牌或黑牌。若双方都出红牌，各得100元；一红一黑，出红者得0元，出黑者得150元；都出黑牌，各得10元。你会出：
q_en: You and your opponent each have a red or black card. If both play red, each gets $100. If one plays red and the other black, the red player gets $0 and the black player gets $150. If both play black, each gets $10. You play:

q_zh: 你与对手各选择一个1-10的整数。谁选的数字更接近对方所选数字的2/3，谁获胜。你会选择：
q_en: You and your opponent each choose an integer from 1 to 10. Whoever chooses the number closest to 2/3 of the opponent's number wins. You choose:

q_zh: 你与对手同时决定是否“合作”。若都合作，各得2分；都不合作，各得1分；一方合作一方背叛，合作者得0分，背叛者得3分。你会：
q_en: You and your opponent simultaneously decide whether to 'cooperate'. If both cooperate, each gets 2 points. If both defect, each gets 1 point. If one cooperates and the other defects, the cooperator gets 0 and the defector gets 3. You:

q_zh: 你与对手进行多轮博弈。每轮可选择“和平”或“攻击”。若双方都选和平，各得2元；若一方攻击一方和平，攻击者得3元，和平者得0元；若都攻击，各损失1元。游戏共10轮。第一轮你会：
q_en: You and your opponent play 10 rounds. Each round, you can choose 'Peace' or 'Attack'. If both choose Peace, each gets $2. If one Attacks and the other chooses Peace, the attacker gets $3 and the peaceful player gets $0. If both Attack, each loses $1. In the first round, you:

q_zh: 你与对手竞拍一件价值100元的物品。出价最高者获胜并支付所出价格，但第二名也需支付自己的出价（且一无所获）。你的出价是：
q_en: You and your opponent bid for an item worth $100. The highest bidder wins and pays their bid, but the second-highest bidder also pays their bid (and gets nothing). Your bid is:

q_zh: 你面前有两个按钮：A按钮确保你获得50元，B按钮有50%概率让你获得100元，50%概率得0元。对手的选择会影响你的收益：若他选A，你的B按钮收益翻倍；若他选B，你的A按钮收益减半。你会按：
q_en: You have two buttons: Button A guarantees you $50. Button B gives you a 50% chance of $100 and 50% of $0. Your opponent's choice affects you: if they choose A, your Button B payout doubles; if they choose B, your Button A payout is halved. You press:

q_zh: 你与对手各自决定是否“投资”。若双方都投资，各得120元；若都不投资，各得20元；若只有一方投资，投资者损失80元，未投资者得40元。你会：
q_en: You and your opponent decide whether to 'invest'. If both invest, each gets $120. If neither invests, each gets $20. If only one invests, the investor loses $80 and the non-investor gets $40. You:

q_zh: 你与对手各自在0-100间选一个数。谁选的数更接近“平均数的2/3”谁获胜。你会选择：
q_en: You and your opponent each choose a number between 0 and 100. Whoever chooses the number closest to 2/3 of the average wins. You choose:

q_zh: 你与对手进行一场拍卖，标的物价值100元。你们轮流加价，每次加价至少1元，无法加价者输掉拍卖但无需付款，获胜者需支付自己的最后一次出价。你先手，你会：
q_en: You are in an auction with an opponent for an item worth $100. You take turns bidding, with each bid at least $1 higher. The loser pays nothing, the winner pays their last bid. You bid first. You will:

q_zh: 在一个合作项目中，你和伙伴可各自选择“全力投入”或“偷懒”。若都全力投入，各得收益3；若都偷懒，各得收益1；若一人投入一人偷懒，投入者得0，偷懒者得5。你会：
q_en: In a joint project, you and a partner can choose 'Work Hard' or 'Shirk'. If both work hard, each gets 3. If both shirk, each gets 1. If one works hard and the other shirks, the hard worker gets 0, the shirker gets 5. You will:

q_zh: 你要将一笔资金委托给一位陌生人投资，对方可选择“归还”或“私吞”。若归还，总金额翻倍并由对方分配；若私吞，对方全得。在委托前，你会：
q_en: You can entrust a sum of money to a stranger for investment. They can 'Return' (double the total and split it) or 'Keep' (take all). Before deciding to entrust, you will:

q_zh: 你与对手同时出示硬币的正面或反面。若相同，你得10元对手得0；若不同，对手得10元你得0。你知道对手是理性且自私的。你会出示：
q_en: You and an opponent simultaneously show Heads or Tails. If they match, you get $10, opponent gets $0. If they differ, opponent gets $10, you get $0. You know the opponent is rational and selfish. You will show:

q_zh: 你参加一场“猜平均数”的竞赛：所有人从0-100选一个数，最接近平均数的2/3者获胜。你认为其他参与者大致是理性的。你会选：
q_en: You are in a 'Guess 2/3 of the Average' game: everyone picks a number 0-100, closest to 2/3 of the average wins. You believe other players are roughly rational. You will pick:

q_zh: 你与对手玩三局两胜的剪刀石头布，目前比分1:1。最后一局前，你可以提议“我们本轮都出剪刀，平局后加赛”，但对方可能反悔。你会：
q_en: You are tied 1-1 in a best-of-three Rock-Paper-Scissors. Before the final round, you can propose 'We both play Scissors for a tie, then play a decider', but the opponent might betray you. You will:
b_zh: 不提议，正常进行最后一局

q_zh: 作为面试官，你怀疑候选人夸大了经历。你可以直接质疑（可能冒犯诚实者），或忽略疑虑（可能雇用说谎者）。你会：
q_en: As an interviewer, you suspect a candidate exaggerated their experience. You can directly challenge (risking offending an honest person) or ignore your doubt (risking hiring a liar). You will:

q_zh: 在多人投票中，你的首选A几乎无胜算，次选B与热门C势均力敌。投票规则为简单多数。你会投给：
q_en: In a multi-candidate vote, your favorite A has no chance. Your second choice B is competitive with the frontrunner C. Plurality voting rule. You will vote for:

q_zh: 你发现同事在工作中有一个小错误。指出错误对团队有益，但可能让对方难堪。错误的影响很小且可能不会被发现。你会：
q_en: You notice a minor mistake by a colleague. Pointing it out helps the team but may embarrass them. The impact is tiny and might go unnoticed. You will:

q_zh: 谈判最后阶段，对方给出了一个略低于你底线的最终报价。你知道若拒绝，双方都将一无所获，且关系可能破裂。你会：
q_en: At the end of a negotiation, the other side makes a final offer slightly below your reservation value. If you reject, both get nothing and the relationship may sour. You will:

q_zh: 你参加一个拍卖，规则是出价最高者获胜，但前两名都需要支付自己的出价。你目前是第二名，且知道第一名的出价。你会选择：
q_en: You are in an auction where the highest bidder wins, but both the top two bidders must pay their bids. You are currently second and know the first-place bid. Do you:
a_zh: 加价超过第一名，争取胜利
a_en: Bid higher than the first place to try to win
b_zh: 保持当前出价，避免更大损失
b_en: Keep your current bid to avoid greater losses

q_zh: 在囚徒困境中，如果对方上一轮选择背叛，你这一轮会：
q_en: In a prisoner's dilemma, if the other player betrayed in the last round, you will:
a_zh: 选择合作，试图重建信任
a_en: Cooperate to try to rebuild trust
b_zh: 选择背叛，以防再次被利用
b_en: Betray to avoid being exploited again

q_zh: 你有一笔钱可以投资两个项目之一：A项目有50%概率翻倍，50%概率损失一半；B项目保证获得25%收益。你会选：
q_en: You can invest in one of two projects: A has a 50% chance to double and 50% chance to lose half; B guarantees a 25% return. You choose:

q_zh: 在谈判中，对方突然给出一个远低于你预期的报价。你会：
q_en: In a negotiation, the other party suddenly makes an offer far below your expectations. You:
a_zh: 直接拒绝并给出你的底线
a_en: Reject directly and state your bottom line
b_zh: 假装接受，但后续寻找机会调整
b_en: Pretend to accept but look for chances to adjust later

q_zh: 团队任务中，有一个成员总是偷懒但分享成果时很积极。你会：
q_en: In a team task, one member is always lazy but very active when sharing results. You:
a_zh: 公开指出问题，要求公平分配
a_en: Point it out publicly and demand fair distribution
b_zh: 私下沟通，避免团队矛盾
b_en: Communicate privately to avoid team conflict

q_zh: 你参加一个游戏，可以选择拿走100元，或者冒险：有10%机会获得2000元，90%机会得0元。你会：
q_en: In a game, you can take $100 or risk: 10% chance to get $2000, 90% chance to get $0. You:

q_zh: 你知道同事的一个秘密，如果透露可能对你有益但会伤害对方。你会：
q_en: You know a colleague's secret that could benefit you if revealed but would hurt them. You:
a_en: Keep the secret to maintain the relationship
b_zh: 透露秘密，争取自身利益
b_en: Reveal the secret to pursue your own interests

q_zh: 在多人投票中，你发现自己的首选注定失败，而次选有机会获胜。你会：
q_en: In a multi-person vote, you see your first choice is doomed to lose, while your second choice has a chance. You:
a_zh: 坚持投给首选，表达立场
a_en: Vote for your first choice to express your stance
b_en: Switch to your second choice to influence the outcome

q_zh: 你预测市场即将下跌，但大多数专家持乐观态度。你会：
q_en: You predict the market will fall, but most experts are optimistic. You:
a_zh: 跟随大众观点，避免特立独行
a_en: Follow the majority to avoid being an outlier
b_zh: 坚持自己的判断，逆向操作
b_en: Stick to your judgment and act contrarily

q_zh: 合作项目中，对方突然要求修改分成比例，对你不利但项目已投入很多。你会：
q_en: In a joint project, the other party suddenly demands to change the profit split to your disadvantage, but much has been invested. You:
a_zh: 接受条件，确保项目完成
a_en: Accept the terms to ensure project completion
b_zh: 拒绝并威胁退出，迫使对方让步
b_en: Refuse and threaten to quit to force concessions

q_zh: 你与对手各自在纸上写下一个1-100之间的整数，谁写的数字更接近对方数字的2/3，谁获胜。你会写多少？
q_en: You and your opponent each write an integer between 1 and 100. Whoever writes a number closest to 2/3 of the opponent's number wins. What number do you write?

q_zh: 你和对手同时决定是否合作。若都合作，各得3分；若都背叛，各得1分；若一人合作一人背叛，背叛者得5分，合作者得0分。你会选择？
q_en: You and your opponent simultaneously decide to cooperate or defect. If both cooperate, each gets 3 points; if both defect, each gets 1 point; if one cooperates and one defects, the defector gets 5 points and the cooperator gets 0. What do you choose?

q_zh: 拍卖一张100元纸币，出价最高者获得纸币，但出价前两名都需要支付自己的出价。你愿意出价多少？
q_en: Auction for a $100 bill. The highest bidder wins the bill, but the top two bidders both pay their bids. How much are you willing to bid?

q_zh: 你和对手轮流从一堆10枚硬币中取走1-3枚，取走最后一枚者输。你先手，第一次会取几枚？
q_en: You and your opponent take turns taking 1-3 coins from a pile of 10 coins. The player who takes the last coin loses. You go first. How many coins do you take on your first turn?

q_zh: 你和对手各有一个秘密数字（1-10），裁判公布两数之和。若你猜中对方的数字，得10分；若对方猜中你的，对方得10分。你会选哪个数字？
q_en: You and your opponent each have a secret number (1-10). The referee announces the sum of the two numbers. If you guess the opponent's number correctly, you get 10 points; if they guess yours, they get 10 points. Which number do you choose?

q_zh: 你与对手分10枚金币。你提出分配方案（如“我7你3”），对方接受则按此分配，拒绝则两人都得不到金币。你会如何提议？
q_en: You and your opponent split 10 gold coins. You propose a distribution (e.g., 'I take 7, you take 3'). If the opponent accepts, the coins are distributed as proposed; if rejected, both get nothing. What do you propose?

q_zh: 你和对手同时选择“红”或“蓝”。若颜色相同，各得100元；若不同，选红者得200元，选蓝者得0元。你会选什么？
q_en: You and your opponent simultaneously choose 'Red' or 'Blue'. If both choose the same color, each gets $100; if different, the one who chose Red gets $200, and the one who chose Blue gets $0. What do you choose?

q_zh: 你和对手各有一个按钮。若都不按，各得2元；若一人按另一人不按，按者得3元，不按者得1元；若都按，各得0元。你会按吗？
q_en: You and your opponent each have a button. If neither presses, each gets $2; if one presses and the other doesn't, the presser gets $3 and the non-presser gets $1; if both press, each gets $0. Do you press the button?

q_zh: 你和对手进行多轮信任游戏。每轮你先决定是否给对方1元（若给，对方收到3元），然后对方决定是否还你2元。这是第一轮，你会给吗？
q_en: You and your opponent play multiple rounds of a trust game. Each round, you first decide whether to give $1 to the opponent (if you give, they receive $3). Then they decide whether to return $2 to you. This is the first round. Do you give?

q_zh: 你和对手各自预测对方会选A还是B。若都预测正确，各得100元；若都错误，各得0元；若一人正确一人错误，正确者得150元，错误者得50元。你预测对方会选？
q_en: You and your opponent each predict whether the other will choose A or B. If both predictions are correct, each gets $100; if both are wrong, each gets $0; if one is correct and the other wrong, the correct one gets $150 and the wrong one gets $50. What do you predict the opponent will choose?

q_zh: 你与对手各自拥有100枚金币。你们需要同时决定是否向公共池投入金币，投入的金币会翻倍后平分给两人。你会选择：
q_en: You and your opponent each have 100 gold coins. You must simultaneously decide whether to contribute coins to a public pool. Contributed coins are doubled and then split equally between both players. You choose to:

q_zh: 在一场拍卖中，你和对手竞拍一张价值100元的钞票。出价最高者获得钞票，但两位竞拍者都需要支付自己的出价。你会出价：
q_en: In an auction, you and your opponent bid for a $100 bill. The highest bidder wins the bill, but both bidders must pay their own bid. You bid:

q_zh: 你和对手轮流从一堆10枚金币中取走1-3枚。取走最后一枚金币的人获胜。现在轮到你，还剩4枚金币。你会取走：
q_en: You and your opponent take turns removing 1-3 gold coins from a pile of 10 coins. The player who takes the last coin wins. It's your turn, and there are 4 coins left. You remove:

q_zh: 你和对手各自秘密写下“合作”或“背叛”。若都写“合作”，各得3分；都写“背叛”，各得1分；一人“合作”一人“背叛”，则背叛者得5分，合作者得0分。你会写：
q_en: You and your opponent secretly write 'Cooperate' or 'Defect'. If both write 'Cooperate', each gets 3 points. If both write 'Defect', each gets 1 point. If one writes 'Cooperate' and the other 'Defect', the defector gets 5 points and the cooperator gets 0. You write:

q_zh: 你面前有两个信封：一个装有对手给你的金额X，另一个装有2X。你可以选择交换信封或不交换。你会：
q_en: You have two envelopes: one contains an amount X given by your opponent, the other contains 2X. You can choose to swap envelopes or not. You:

q_zh: 你和对手分10枚金币。对手先提出分配方案（如“我7你3”），你可以接受或拒绝。若拒绝，双方都得不到金币。对手提出“我8你2”。你会：
q_en: You and your opponent split 10 coins. The opponent first proposes a split (e.g., '7 for me, 3 for you'). You can accept or reject. If rejected, both get nothing. The opponent proposes '8 for me, 2 for you'. You:

q_zh: 你和对手玩三局“剪刀石头布”。每局胜者得1分，平局各得0.5分。已知对手第一局必出“石头”。你第一局会出：
q_en: You and your opponent play three rounds of Rock-Paper-Scissors. Each win gives 1 point, a draw gives 0.5 points each. You know the opponent will definitely play 'Rock' in the first round. In the first round, you play:

q_zh: 你和对手各自决定是否投资一个项目。若都投资，各获利4；都不投资，各获利2；仅一人投资，投资者亏损1，不投资者获利3。你会：
q_en: You and your opponent each decide whether to invest in a project. If both invest, each gains 4. If neither invests, each gains 2. If only one invests, the investor loses 1 and the non-investor gains 3. You:

q_zh: 你和对手轮流报数，从1开始，每次可报1-3个数，先报到30的人获胜。现在轮到你，当前数字是26。你会报：
q_en: You and your opponent take turns counting numbers starting from 1, each can say 1 to 3 numbers per turn. The one who says '30' wins. It's your turn, and the current number is 26. You say:

q_zh: 你和对手各自选择“红”或“蓝”。若颜色相同，各得10分；若不同，选“红”者得0分，选“蓝”者得15分。你会选：
q_en: You and your opponent each choose 'Red' or 'Blue'. If the colors match, each gets 10 points. If they differ, the one who chose 'Red' gets 0, and the one who chose 'Blue' gets 15. You choose:

q_zh: 你参加一个拍卖会，规则是出价最高者获胜，但前两名出价者都需要支付自己的出价。你会：
q_en: You participate in an auction where the highest bidder wins, but both the top two bidders must pay their bids. You will:
a_zh: 出价远低于物品价值，避免陷入“赢家诅咒”
a_en: Bid well below the item's value to avoid the "winner's curse"
b_zh: 出价接近物品价值，争取以合理价格获胜
b_en: Bid close to the item's value, aiming to win at a reasonable price

q_zh: 作为公司经理，你要在两个项目中分配预算。项目A成功率80%但收益一般；项目B成功率40%但收益很高。你会：
q_en: As a manager, you must allocate budget between two projects. Project A has 80% success chance with moderate returns; Project B has 40% chance with high returns. You will:
a_zh: 选择项目A，稳健的回报更符合公司长期利益
a_en: Choose Project A, as stable returns better serve long-term interests
b_zh: 选择项目B，高风险高回报可能带来突破
b_en: Choose Project B, as high risk/high return could bring breakthrough

q_zh: 在合作谈判中，对方突然提出一个明显不公平的方案。你会：
q_en: In a cooperative negotiation, the other party suddenly proposes an obviously unfair deal. You will:
a_zh: 直接拒绝并给出你的公平方案
a_en: Reject it directly and present your fair counter-proposal
b_zh: 先接受部分条款，在后续谈判中逐步调整
b_en: Accept some terms first, then gradually adjust in later negotiations

q_zh: 团队面临危机，你需要决定是否公开所有信息。公开可能引起恐慌，不公开可能被指责隐瞒。你会：
q_en: Your team faces a crisis. You must decide whether to disclose all information. Disclosure may cause panic; non-disclosure may lead to accusations of concealment. You will:
a_zh: 选择性公开，控制信息节奏以稳定局面
a_en: Disclose selectively, controlling information flow to stabilize the situation
b_zh: 完全公开，透明化处理以建立长期信任
b_en: Disclose fully, handling transparently to build long-term trust

q_zh: 市场竞争激烈，对手刚刚降价。你会：
q_en: Market competition is intense; a competitor just lowered prices. You will:
a_zh: 立即跟进降价，保持市场份额
a_en: Immediately match the price cut to maintain market share
b_zh: 保持价格但增加服务价值，避免价格战
b_en: Maintain price but add service value, avoiding price war

q_zh: 你需要从两名候选人中选一个搭档。候选人A能力突出但难以预测；候选人B能力中等但非常可靠。你会选择：
q_en: You must choose a partner from two candidates. Candidate A is highly capable but unpredictable; Candidate B is moderately capable but very reliable. You choose:
a_zh: 候选人A，卓越能力值得承担一定风险
a_en: Candidate A, as exceptional ability is worth some risk
b_zh: 候选人B，可靠性对合作成功至关重要
b_en: Candidate B, as reliability is crucial for successful partnership

q_zh: 在多方博弈中，你发现两个对手可能私下结盟。你会：
q_en: In a multi-party game, you suspect two opponents may have formed a private alliance. You will:
a_zh: 公开质疑他们的关系，破坏潜在联盟
a_en: Publicly question their relationship to disrupt the potential alliance
b_zh: 私下接触其中一方，尝试建立自己的联盟
b_en: Privately approach one party to try forming your own alliance

q_zh: 投资决策时，你更倾向于：
q_en: When making investment decisions, you tend to:
a_zh: 分散投资以降低整体风险
a_en: Diversify investments to reduce overall risk
b_zh: 集中投资最有信心的领域
b_en: Concentrate investments in areas of highest confidence

q_zh: 当团队出现内部冲突时，作为领导者你会：
q_en: When internal conflict arises within the team, as a leader you will:
a_zh: 立即介入调解，明确规则和界限
a_en: Intervene immediately to mediate, establishing clear rules and boundaries
b_zh: 允许冲突暂时存在，观察团队自我调节能力
b_en: Allow conflict to exist temporarily, observing the team's self-regulation ability

q_zh: 面对一个可能改变行业的新技术，但早期采用风险很大。你会：
q_en: Facing a new technology that could change the industry, but early adoption carries high risk. You will:
a_zh: 成为早期采用者，抢占市场先机
a_en: Become an early adopter to seize market advantage
b_zh: 等待技术成熟后再跟进，降低风险
b_en: Wait for the technology to mature before following, reducing risk

q_zh: 你与对手各自秘密写下1-10中的一个整数。若两数之和为奇数，你获得对手写的数字的金额；若为偶数，对手获得你写的数字的金额。你会写哪个数字？
q_en: You and your opponent secretly write an integer from 1 to 10. If the sum is odd, you win the amount equal to your opponent's number. If the sum is even, your opponent wins the amount equal to your number. Which number do you write?

q_zh: 你和对手各持10枚金币。你们同时决定捐出多少金币（0-10）给公共池。公共池的总和会翻倍后平分给两人。你会捐多少？
q_en: You and your opponent each have 10 gold coins. You simultaneously decide how many to contribute (0-10) to a public pool. The total in the pool is doubled and split equally between you two. How much do you contribute?

q_zh: 你要在两个选项中做出选择，对手会预测你的选择。若对手预测正确，他得2分你不得分；若预测错误，你得1分他不得分。你会如何选择？
q_en: You choose between two options, and your opponent predicts your choice. If correct, they get 2 points and you get 0. If wrong, you get 1 point and they get 0. How do you choose?
a_zh: 随机选择（如抛硬币决定）
b_zh: 固定选择一个选项（如总是选A）
b_en: Stick to one option consistently (e.g., always choose A)

q_zh: 你和对手轮流从一堆15枚金币中取走1-3枚。取走最后一枚金币的人获胜。你先手，你会取几枚？
q_en: You and your opponent take turns taking 1-3 gold coins from a pile of 15. The one who takes the last coin wins. You go first. How many do you take?

q_zh: 你面前有两个按钮：A按钮给你100元，但对手会得到200元；B按钮给你80元，但对手只得40元。你会按哪个？
q_en: You have two buttons: Button A gives you ¥100 but gives your opponent ¥200. Button B gives you ¥80 but gives your opponent only ¥40. Which do you press?

q_zh: 你和对手各自决定是否“合作”。若都合作，各得3分；若都背叛，各得1分；若一方合作一方背叛，背叛者得5分，合作者得0分。你会？
q_en: You and your opponent decide whether to 'Cooperate'. If both cooperate, each gets 3 points. If both betray, each gets 1. If one betrays and one cooperates, the betrayer gets 5 and the cooperator gets 0. What do you do?

q_zh: 你要将100元在自己和对手间分配。对手可以接受或拒绝。若接受，按你的方案分钱；若拒绝，两人都得0元。你会分给对手多少？
q_en: You propose how to split ¥100 between you and your opponent. They can accept or reject. If accepted, the split stands. If rejected, both get ¥0. How much do you offer the opponent?
a_zh: 分给对手较少金额（如10-30元）
b_zh: 分给对手接近一半（如40-50元）

q_zh: 你和对手玩三局“石头剪刀布”。每局胜者得1分。已知对手第一局会出“石头”。你第一局会出什么？
q_en: You play three rounds of Rock-Paper-Scissors. Each win earns 1 point. You know the opponent will play 'Rock' in the first round. What do you play first?
b_zh: 出“剪刀”（故意输掉第一局）

q_zh: 拍卖一张价值100元的钞票，你和对手轮流出价，每次加价至少1元。出价最高者支付所出价格并获得钞票。你先从1元开始叫价，你会叫到多少？
q_en: You auction a ¥100 bill. You and your opponent take turns bidding, increasing by at least ¥1 each time. The highest bidder pays their bid and gets the bill. You start by bidding ¥1. How high will you go?
a_zh: 在较低价格退出（如不超过50元）
a_en: Drop out at a low price (e.g., not above ¥50)

q_zh: 你与对手进行多轮博弈。每轮你可以选择“信任”或“不信任”。若双方都“信任”，各得2分；若一方“信任”一方“不信任”，“不信任”方得3分，“信任”方得-1分；若都“不信任”，各得0分。你会如何开始？
q_en: You play multiple rounds with an opponent. Each round, you can choose 'Trust' or 'Distrust'. If both trust, each gets 2 points. If one distrusts and one trusts, the distrusting player gets 3, the trusting player gets -1. If both distrust, each gets 0. How do you start?

q_zh: 你与对手各持100元，同时决定是否捐赠给对方一部分。若双方都捐赠，则各自保留的钱翻倍；若只有一方捐赠，则捐赠者的钱归对方所有；若都不捐赠，则保留原有钱。你会选择：
q_en: You and an opponent each hold $100, and simultaneously decide whether to donate a portion to the other. If both donate, each keeps their money doubled; if only one donates, the donor's money goes to the other; if neither donates, both keep their original money. You choose:

q_zh: 在一场拍卖中，出价最高者赢得奖品，但前两名出价者都需支付自己的出价金额。你已知对手大概率会出价50元，你会出价：
q_en: In an auction, the highest bidder wins the prize, but the top two bidders both pay their bid amounts. You know your opponent is likely to bid $50. You bid:

q_zh: 两人分10枚金币，由你提出分配方案（如“我得X枚，对方得Y枚”），对方可选择接受或拒绝。若拒绝，双方都得不到金币。你会提议：
q_en: Two people split 10 gold coins. You propose a distribution (e.g., 'I get X, the other gets Y'). The other can accept or reject. If rejected, both get nothing. You propose:

q_zh: 你与对手轮流从20枚硬币中取走1-3枚，取走最后一枚者输。现在轮到你，还剩4枚硬币。你会取走：
q_en: You and an opponent take turns removing 1-3 coins from a pile of 20. The one who takes the last coin loses. It's your turn, with 4 coins left. You remove:

q_zh: 你们各自在0-100间选一个数，最接近平均数的2/3者获胜。你认为多数人会随机选数，你会选：
q_en: Each chooses a number between 0 and 100. The one closest to 2/3 of the average wins. You think most people will choose randomly. You choose:

q_zh: 合作任务中，你们可各自选择“全力投入”或“偷懒”。若都全力投入，各得3分；都偷懒，各得1分；若一人偷懒一人投入，偷懒者得5分，投入者得0分。你会：
q_en: In a cooperative task, each can choose 'full effort' or 'slack off'. If both choose full effort, each gets 3 points; if both slack off, each gets 1; if one slacks and the other works, the slacker gets 5 points, the worker gets 0. You choose:

q_zh: 你需猜测对手在“红/蓝”二选一中的选择。若猜对，你得2分；若猜错，对手得1分。你会猜：
q_en: You must guess your opponent's choice between 'Red' or 'Blue'. If correct, you get 2 points; if wrong, opponent gets 1 point. You guess:

q_zh: 你们各自决定是否信任对方：若互信，各得3元；若互不信任，各得1元；若一方信任而另一方背叛，背叛者得5元，信任者得0元。你会：
q_en: Each decides whether to trust the other: if both trust, each gets $3; if both distrust, each gets $1; if one trusts and the other betrays, the betrayer gets $5, the truster gets $0. You choose:

q_zh: 你与对手各有一个按钮，若都在10秒内按下，各得100元；若只有一人按下，按下者罚10元，未按者得50元；若都不按，各得0元。你会：
q_en: Each has a button. If both press within 10 seconds, each gets $100; if only one presses, the presser loses $10, the non-presser gets $50; if neither presses, both get $0. You choose:

q_zh: 你面前有两个信封：一个含X元，另一个含2X元。你随机选一个并打开，发现是100元。此时你可以选择交换另一个信封。你会：
q_en: Two envelopes: one contains $X, the other contains $2X. You randomly pick one and open it, finding $100. You may switch to the other envelope. You choose:

q_zh: 你与对手各自秘密写下0-100之间的一个整数，谁写的数字更接近对方数字的2/3，谁获胜。你会写多少？
q_en: You and your opponent secretly write an integer between 0 and 100. Whoever writes a number closest to 2/3 of the other's number wins. What number do you write?

q_zh: 在一个拍卖中，出价最高者赢得100元，但出价最高和第二高的人都必须支付自己的出价。你会出价多少？
q_en: In an auction, the highest bidder wins $100, but both the highest and second-highest bidders must pay their bids. How much do you bid?

q_zh: 你和对手轮流从一堆10枚硬币中取走1-3枚，取走最后一枚的人输。你先手，第一轮取几枚？
q_en: You and your opponent take turns taking 1-3 coins from a pile of 10 coins. The player who takes the last coin loses. You go first. How many coins do you take on your first turn?

q_zh: 两人分10元，A提出分配方案，B决定接受或拒绝。若拒绝，两人都得0元。作为A，你提议如何分？
q_en: Two people split $10. A proposes how to divide it, and B decides to accept or reject. If rejected, both get $0. As A, how do you propose to split?

q_zh: 你和对手同时决定“合作”或“背叛”。若都合作，各得3分；都背叛，各得1分；一方合作一方背叛，背叛者得5分，合作者得0分。你会选择？
q_en: You and your opponent simultaneously choose 'Cooperate' or 'Defect'. If both cooperate, each gets 3 points; both defect, each gets 1 point; if one cooperates and one defects, the defector gets 5 points, the cooperator gets 0. What do you choose?

q_zh: 你面前有两个信封，一个装的钱是另一个的两倍。你随机选了一个，打开前，是否愿意换成另一个？
q_en: You are given two envelopes, one containing twice as much money as the other. You randomly pick one. Before opening it, are you willing to switch to the other?

q_zh: 你和对手各有一张红牌或黑牌。同时亮出，若颜色相同，你付他1元；颜色不同，他付你1元。你出什么牌？
q_en: You and your opponent each have a red or black card. You reveal simultaneously. If the colors match, you pay him $1; if they differ, he pays you $1. What card do you play?

q_zh: 你和对手竞猜一个0-100之间的随机数，谁猜的数字最接近该数的一半，谁获胜。你猜多少？
q_en: You and your opponent guess a random number between 0 and 100. Whoever guesses closest to half of that number wins. What do you guess?

q_zh: 你与对手进行多轮囚徒困境，已知共进行10轮。在第一轮，你会选择合作还是背叛？
q_en: You and your opponent play multiple rounds of the Prisoner's Dilemma, knowing there will be exactly 10 rounds. In the first round, do you choose to cooperate or defect?

q_zh: 你参加一个游戏：主持人蒙上你的眼睛，在你头上随机放一顶红或蓝的帽子。你和另外两人站成一排，每人能看到前面所有人的帽子颜色。从最后一人开始，依次猜自己帽子的颜色。你处在中间位置，轮到你时，你会猜什么颜色？
q_en: You play a game: the host blindfolds you and randomly places a red or blue hat on your head. You and two others stand in a line, each seeing all hats in front. Starting from the last person, each guesses their own hat color. You are in the middle. When it's your turn, what color do you guess?

q_zh: 你参加一场拍卖会，规则是出价最高者获胜，但前两名都需要支付自己的出价。你目前是第二名，且价格已远超物品实际价值。你会：
q_en: You are in an auction where the highest bidder wins, but the top two bidders both pay their bids. You are currently second, and the price far exceeds the item's actual value. Do you:
a_zh: 继续加价，试图反超第一名
a_en: Bid higher to overtake the first place
b_zh: 立即退出，避免更大损失
b_en: Drop out immediately to avoid greater loss

q_zh: 你和对手各自在纸上写一个1-10之间的整数。若两数之和≤10，你们各得自己写的数字的奖金；若＞10，都得0。你会写：
q_en: You and an opponent each write an integer from 1 to 10. If the sum ≤10, each gets their number as prize; if >10, both get 0. You write:

q_zh: 在多人投票淘汰游戏中，你发现两名强者结盟。此时你会：
q_en: In a multiplayer elimination game, you find two strong players forming an alliance. Do you:
a_zh: 联合其他弱者先淘汰一名强者
a_en: Unite with other weak players to eliminate one strong player first
b_zh: 尝试加入强者联盟以求自保
b_en: Try to join the strong alliance for self-preservation

q_zh: 谈判中对方提出一个对你明显不利的方案，但强调‘这是最终报价’。你会：
q_en: In a negotiation, the other party offers a clearly unfavorable deal but insists 'this is the final offer.' Do you:
a_zh: 直接拒绝，并准备离开谈判桌
a_en: Reject it outright and prepare to walk away
b_zh: 假装接受，但后续寻找条款漏洞
b_en: Pretend to accept, then look for loopholes later

q_zh: 团队任务中，你的贡献远超他人，但奖励会平均分配。下一轮任务你会：
q_en: In a team task, your contribution far exceeds others, but rewards are split equally. In the next round, do you:
a_zh: 继续全力付出，相信公平终会到来
a_en: Continue giving your all, believing fairness will come
b_zh: 刻意减少努力，达到团队平均水平
b_en: Deliberately reduce effort to match the team average

q_zh: 猜拳比赛中，对手已连续出两次‘石头’。下一局你会出：
q_en: In a rock-paper-scissors tournament, your opponent has played 'rock' twice in a row. Next round you play:
a_zh: 剪刀（预判对方会以为你出布）
a_en: Scissors (anticipating they'll think you'll play paper)
b_zh: 布（相信对方会坚持出石头）

q_zh: 投资游戏中，你已亏损30%。此时有一个高风险高回报的翻盘机会，你会：
q_en: In an investment game, you've lost 30%. There's a high-risk, high-reward chance to recover. Do you:
a_zh: 投入剩余资金的70%搏一把
a_en: Invest 70% of remaining funds to gamble
b_en: Invest only 10%, preserving capital for stability

q_zh: 匿名投票决定是否惩罚一名违规者。你知道如果惩罚他，自己会获益，但对方会受损。你会：
q_en: An anonymous vote decides whether to punish a rule-breaker. You know punishing them benefits you but harms them. Do you:
a_zh: 投票赞成惩罚（理性选择）
b_zh: 投票反对惩罚（出于同情）

q_zh: 最后一块蛋糕，你和另一人都想要。对方提议‘石头剪刀布’决定。你会：
q_en: There's one piece of cake left, and both you and another person want it. They suggest rock-paper-scissors. Do you:
b_zh: 提议平分，避免运气决定
b_en: Propose splitting it to avoid luck deciding

q_zh: 在信息不对称的交易中，你发现对方未察觉商品的隐藏缺陷。你会：
q_en: In an asymmetric information trade, you discover a hidden defect the other party is unaware of. Do you:
a_zh: 主动告知缺陷，寻求公平交易
a_en: Disclose the defect and seek a fair deal
b_zh: 隐瞒缺陷，按原价完成交易
b_en: Conceal the defect and complete the trade at original price
